title: Declared finite linear influence identities
statement: For the declared finite synchronous family, complete mixing has drift -Cov_n(alpha,x); constant alpha preserves the mean. Homogeneous transport has drift a Cov_n(W^T 1,x), not generally a covariance with degree. Correlation size requires an explicit covariance law and a nonzero denominator. A declared normalized nonnegative left-stationary vector preserves its weighted mean under homogeneous alpha.
assumptions: n>=1; rational finite vectors in executable cases
Row-stochastic W; alpha in [0,1]^n; zero noise; linear coordinates
The homogeneous transport identity additionally requires constant alpha
K_corr uses the declared covariance, not keys, Kish, accuracy or causal independence
Weighted-mean interpretation requires declared nonnegative normalized w with w^T W=w^T and homogeneous alpha.
boundary: T2 is excluded. Finite identities are kernel-checked over rationals; no general real convergence or stochastic covariance theorem is claimed by the finite cases.
status: Lean identities plus exact finite vectors; covariance evolution derivation separated from its scalar normalization
runtimeAPI: No new runtime export; these contracts and their native finite witnesses extend the admitted theory without duplicating the engine.
